_comment: Named capability SLOTS -> MCP server config. A member declares a slot in llm.capabilities (e.g. "design_reference"), never a server name -- swapping the tool behind a slot means editing one line here, no charter or member-spec edit. run_member.sh resolves slot -> server -> --mcp-config entry + mcp__<server> in --allowedTools. See scripts/member_spec.py's llm.capabilities validation and scripts/run_member.sh's MCP block.
